verses.en: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel, and all the heads of the tribes, the chief of the fathers of the children of Israel, unto king Solomon in Jerusalem, that they might bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD out of the city of David, which is Zion.
verses.sm: ONA faapotopotoina lea e Solouma o itu aiga, o alii sili o le fanauga a Isaraelu, i le tupu o Solomona i Ierusalema, ina ia latou avae le atolaau o le feagaiga a ieova mai le aai a Tavita, o Siona lea.

verses.en: And all the men of Israel assembled themselves unto king Solomon at the feast in the month Ethanim, which is the seventh month.
verses.sm: Ua faapotopotoina mai foi i le tupu o Solomona o tagata uma o Isaraelu i le tausamiga i le masina o Etanima, o le masina e fitu lea.

verses.en: And all the elders of Israel came, and the priests took up the ark.
verses.sm: Na o mai toeaina uma o Isaraelu, ua avae foi e le au faitaulaga le atolaau.

verses.en: And they brought up the ark of the LORD, and the tabernacle of the congregation, and all the holy vessels that were in the tabernacle, even those did the priests and the Levites bring up.
verses.sm: Ua avae e i latou le atolaau a Ieova, ma le fale f etaf ai o le f aapotopotoga, ma mea paia uma lava na i ai i le fale fetafai; ua avae ia lava mea e le au faitaulaga ma sa Levi.

verses.en: And king Solomon, and all the congregation of Israel, that were assembled unto him, were with him before the ark, sacrificing sheep and oxen, that could not be told nor numbered for multitude.
verses.sm: O le tupu o Solomona, ma le faapotopotoga uma o Isaraelu ua faapotopotoina mai ia te ia, sa i ai i latou ma ia i luma o le atolaau, o loo fai taulaga i mamoe ma povi, e le masino e le mafaitaulia foi, auā ua tele lava.

verses.en: And the priests brought in the ark of the covenant of the LORD unto his place, into the oracle of the house, to the most holy place, even under the wings of the cherubims.
verses.sm: Ua ave foi e le au faitaulaga le atolaau o le feagaiga a Ieova i le mea e tuu ai, o le mea e fetalai mai ai o i le fale, o le mea e sili ona paia,

verses.en: For the cherubims spread forth their two wings over the place of the ark, and the cherubims covered the ark and the staves thereof above.
verses.sm: i lalo o apaau o kerupi; auā ua faaloaloa e kerupi o la apaau e lua i luga o le mea e tuu ai le atolaau; ua faamalumalu foi kerupi i luga o le atolaau, ma luga o ona amo.

verses.en: And they drew out the staves, that the ends of the staves were seen out in the holy place before the oracle, and they were not seen without: and there they are unto this day.
verses.sm: Ua latou tosina mai amo, ua iloa foi pito amo i le mea paia i luma o le mea e fetalai mai ai; a e lei iloa i fafo; o loo i ai ua oo i ona po nei.

verses.en: There was nothing in the ark save the two tables of stone, which Moses put there at Horeb, when the LORD made a covenant with the children of Israel, when they came out of the land of Egypt.
verses.sm: Ua le i ai se mea i le atolaau, ua na o papamaa e lua na tuuina ai e Mose i Horepa, ina ua osia le feagaiga e Ieova ma le fanauga a Isaraelu, ina ua latou o mai mai le nuu o Aikupito.

verses.en: And it came to pass, when the priests were come out of the holy place, that the cloud filled the house of the LORD,
verses.sm: Ua ulufafo le au faitaulaga ai le mea paia, ona tumu lea o le fale o Ieova i le ao.

verses.en: So that the priests could not stand to minister because of the cloud: for the glory of the LORD had filled the house of the LORD.
verses.sm: Ua le mafai le au faitaulaga ona tutū e auauna ona o le ao ; auā ua tumu le fale o Ieova i le pupula o Ieova.

verses.en: Then spake Solomon, The LORD said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.
verses.sm: Ona faapea atu lea o Solomona, Na fetalai mai Ieova, e afio o ia i le pogisa.

verses.en: I have surely built thee an house to dwell in, a settled place for thee to abide in for ever.
verses.sm: Ua ou faia lava le fale mo oe e te afio ai, o le afioaga e te afio ai e faavavau.

verses.en: And the king turned his face about, and blessed all the congregation of Israel: (and all the congregation of Israel stood;)
verses.sm: Ona liliu atu lea o le tupu, ma faamanuia atu i le faapotopotoga uma o Isaraelu ; ua tutū mai foi le faapotopotoga unaa o Isaraelu;

verses.en: And he said, Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, which spake with his mouth unto David my father, and hath with his hand fulfilled it, saying,
verses.sm: ua ia faapea atu, Ia faafetaia Ieova le Atua o Isaraelu, o le na tulei mai lona siufofoga i lo‘u tamā o Tavita, ma ua faataunuuina mai i lona aao, ua faapea mai,

verses.en: Since the day that I brought forth my people Israel out of Egypt, I chose no city out of all the tribes of Israel to build an house, that my name might be therein; but I chose David to be over my people Israel.
verses.sm: Talu lava le aso na ou au mai ai lo‘u nuu o Isaraelu mai Aikupito, ou te lei filifilia se aai i itu aiga uma o Isaraelu e fai ai se fale, ina ia i ai lo‘u igoa; a o Tavita ua ou filifilia o ia e pule i lo‘u nuu o Isaraelu.

verses.en: And it was in the heart of David my father to build an house for the name of the LORD God of Israel.
verses.sm: Sa loto foi lo‘u tamā o Tavita e fai se fale mo le suafa o Ieova le Atua o Isaraelu.

verses.en: And the LORD said unto David my father, Whereas it was in thine heart to build an house unto my name, thou didst well that it was in thine heart.
verses.sm: Na fetalai mai ieova i lo‘u tamā o Tavita, Auā ua e loto ina fai se fale i lo‘u igoa ua lelei ina ua i ai i lou loto.

verses.en: Nevertheless thou shalt not build the house; but thy son that shall come forth out of thy loins, he shall build the house unto my name.
verses.sm: A e peitai oe5 e te le faia le fale; a o lou atalii, o lau lava fanau, o ia na te faia le fale mo lo‘u igoa.

verses.en: And the LORD hath performed his word that he spake, and I am risen up in the room of David my father, and sit on the throne of Israel, as the LORD promised, and have built an house for the name of the LORD God of Israel.
verses.sm: Ua faataunuuina foi e Ieova o lana afioga na ia fetalaia mai, ua nofo atu foi a‘u e fai ma sui o lo‘u tamā o Tavita, ua ou tietie foi i le nofoālii o Isaraelu, e faapei ona fetalai mai ai Ieova, ua ou faia foi le fale mo le suafa o Ieova le Atua 0 Isaraelu.

verses.en: And I have set there a place for the ark, wherein is the covenant of the LORD, which he made with our fathers, when he brought them out of the land of Egypt.
verses.sm: Ua ou saunia foi i ai se mea e tuu ai le atolaau, o loo i ai le feagaiga a Ieova na ia osia ma o tatou tamā ina ua aumaia i latou e ia inai le nuu o Aikupito.

verses.en: And Solomon stood before the altar of the LORD in the presence of all the congregation of Israel, and spread forth his hands toward heaven:
verses.sm: Ona tulai atu lea o Solomona i luma o le fata faitaulaga o IeoVa, i luma o le faapotopotoga uma o Isaraelu, ua na faaloaloa ae foi ona lima i le lagi;

verses.en: And he said, LORD God of Israel, there is no God like thee, in heaven above, or on earth beneath, who keepest covenant and mercy with thy servants that walk before thee with all their heart:
verses.sm: ua faapea atu foi o ia, Ieova e, le Atua o Isaraelu, e leai se atua e tusa ma oe i le lagi i luga, po o le lalolagi i lalo nei, 0 loo e tausia le feagaiga ma le alofa i au auauna o e savavali i ou luma ma o latou loto atoa;

verses.en: Who hast kept with thy servant David my father that thou promisedst him: thou spakest also with thy mouth, and hast fulfilled it with thine hand, as it is this day.
verses.sm: o oe ila e tausia i lau auauna o Tavita lo‘u tamā 0 le mea na e fetalai mai ai ia te ia; na e fetalai mai i loU fofoga, o lou aao foi ua e faataunuuina ai, e faapei ona fai i le aso nei.

verses.en: Therefore now, LORD God of Israel, keep with thy servant David my father that thou promisedst him, saying, There shall not fail thee a man in my sight to sit on the throne of Israel; so that thy children take heed to their way, that they walk before me as thou hast walked before me.
verses.sm: O lenei, ieova e, le Atua o Isaraelu, Ia e tausia i lau auauna o Tavita lo‘u tamā o le mea na e fetalai mai ai ia te ia, ua faapea mai, E le aunoa se tagata ia te oe i o‘u luma e tietie i le nofoālii o Isaraelu; tau lava ina tausia e au fanau o latou ala, ina ia latoU savavali i o‘u luma, e pei ona e savali i o‘u luma.

verses.en: And now, O God of Israel, let thy word, I pray thee, be verified, which thou spakest unto thy servant David my father.
verses.sm: O lenei, le Atua o Isaraelu e, se‘i faamaonia lau afioga na e fetalaia mai i lau auauna o Tavita Atua i le lalolagi ?

verses.en: But will God indeed dwell on the earth? behold, the heaven and heaven of heavens cannot contain thee; how much less this house that I have builded?
verses.sm: Paauta, o le lagi ma le lagi o lagi, e le ofi ai oe, e le atili ai ea ona e le ofi i lenei fale ua ou faia ?

verses.en: Yet have thou respect unto the prayer of thy servant, and to his supplication, O LORD my God, to hearken unto the cry and to the prayer, which thy servant prayeth before thee to day:
verses.sm: A ia e liuliualo mai i le tatalo a lau auauna ma lana aioi, Ieova e, lo‘u Atua, ma faafofoga mai i le valaau ma le tatalo, o loo talotalo ai lau au.auna i ou luma i le aso nei;

verses.en: That thine eyes may be open toward this house night and day, even toward the place of which thou hast said, My name shall be there: that thou mayest hearken unto the prayer which thy servant shall make toward this place.
verses.sm: ina ia silasila mai ou fofoga i lenei fale i le po atoa ma le ao, o le mea na e fetalai mai ai, E i ai lo‘u igoa: ina ia e faafofoga mai i le tatalo e tatalo atu ai lau auauna i lenei mea.

verses.en: And hearken thou to the supplication of thy servant, and of thy people Israel, when they shall pray toward this place: and hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place: and when thou hearest, forgive.
verses.sm: Ia e fāafofoga mai foi i le aioi a lau auauna, ma lou nuu o Isaraelu, pe a latou tatalo atu i lenei mea; ia e faafofoga mai foi mai le lagi 5 le mea o loo e afio ai; ia e faafofoga mai, ma ia e faamagalo mai.

verses.en: If any man trespass against his neighbour, and an oath be laid upon him to cause him to swear, and the oath come before thine altar in this house:
verses.sm: Afai e agasala se tasi tagata i le tasi, ma ua fai atu o ia ia te ia na te faia se tautoga, ina ia tauto ai o ia, a oo mai foi le tautoga i luma o lou fata faitaulaga i lenei fale;

verses.en: Then hear thou in heaven, and do, and judge thy servants, condemning the wicked, to bring his way upon his head; and justifying the righteous, to give him according to his righteousness.
verses.sm: ia e faafofoga mai i le lagi, ma ia e faia le faamasinoga i au auauna, e faasala i le ua amioleaga, ia tauia lana amio ia te ia lava; e ta‘u amiotonuina. foi le ua amiotonu, ia foaiina atu ia te ia e tusa ma lana amiotonu;

verses.en: When thy people Israel be smitten down before the enemy, because they have sinned against thee, and shall turn again to thee, and confess thy name, and pray, and make supplication unto thee in this house:
verses.sm: A fasia lōu nuu 6 Isaraelu i luma o e ita mai, ina ua latou agasala atu ia te oe ; a latou toe foi mai ia te oe, ma ta‘uta‘u atu lou suafa, ma tatalo, ma aioi atu ia te oe i lenei fale;

verses.en: Then hear thou in heaven, and forgive the sin of thy people Israel, and bring them again unto the land which thou gavest unto their fathers.
verses.sm: ia e faafofoga mai i le lagi, ma e faamagalo mai le agasala a lou nuu o Isaraelu, ma e faafoisia mai i latōu i le laueleele na e foaiina mai i o latou tamā;

verses.en: When heaven is shut up, and there is no rain, because they have sinned against thee; if they pray toward this place, and confess thy name, and turn from their sin, when thou afflictest them:
verses.sm: A punitia le lagi, ma ua leai se ua, ina ua latou agasala atu ia te oe ; afai latou te tatalo i lenei mea, ma latou ta‘uta‘u atu lou suafa, ma liliu ese i a latou agasala, pe a e faatiga ia te i latou;

verses.en: Then hear thou in heaven, and forgive the sin of thy servants, and of thy people Israel, that thou teach them the good way wherein they should walk, and give rain upon thy land, which thou hast given to thy people for an inheritance.
verses.sm: ia e faafogafoga māi i le lagi, ma e faamagalo mai le agasala a au auauna, ma lou nuu o Isaraelu, ma ia e a‘oa‘o ia te i latou i le ala lelei latou te savavali ai; ia e foai mai foi le ua i luga o lou laueleele, na e foaiina mai i lou nuu e fai mo latou tofi. nuu afai i ai le faamafi, po o le mamae, le polopologā, po o le se akerise,

verses.en: If there be in the land famine, if there be pestilence, blasting, mildew, locust, or if there be caterpiller; if their enemy besiege them in the land of their cities; whatsoever plague, whatsoever sickness there be;
verses.sm: afai foi e i ai le se kasili; afai foi e siosiomia i latou i le nuu o i ai a latou aai e i latou o e ita mai; so se mala, po o se maā e i ai;

verses.en: What prayer and supplication soever be made by any man, or by all thy people Israel, which shall know every man the plague of his own heart, and spread forth his hands toward this house:
verses.sm: o talosaga uma ma aioi uma e faia e se tagata, po o lou nuu o Isaraelu uma; e taitasi uma o e iloa le tiga o latou loto, ma faaloaloa o latou lima i lenei fale;

verses.en: Then hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place, and forgive, and do, and give to every man according to his ways, whose heart thou knowest; (for thou, even thou only, knowest the hearts of all the children of men;)
verses.sm: ia e faafofoga mai mai le lagi, o le mea o loo e afio ai, ma e faamagalo mai, ma e faia, ma foai mai i tagata taitoatasi e tusa ma ana amio uma, ua e silafia lona loto; auā na o oe lava ua e silafia loto o tagata uma lava;

verses.en: That they may fear thee all the days that they live in the land which thou gavest unto our fathers.
verses.sm: ina ia latou matatau ia te oe i aso uma latou te ola ai i le laueleele na e foaiina mai i o matou tamā.

verses.en: Moreover concerning a stranger, that is not of thy people Israel, but cometh out of a far country for thy name's sake;
verses.sm: O le tagata ese foi, e le so lou nuu o Isaraelu, a ua sau o ia mai le nuu mamao ona o lou suafa;

verses.en: (For they shall hear of thy great name, and of thy strong hand, and of thy stretched out arm;) when he shall come and pray toward this house;
verses.sm: (auā e faalogo i latou i lou suafa mamalu, ma lou aao malosi, ma lou aao faaloaloa;) pe a sau o ia, ma tatalo i lenei fale;

verses.en: Hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place, and do according to all that the stranger calleth to thee for: that all people of the earth may know thy name, to fear thee, as do thy people Israel; and that they may know that this house, which I have builded, is called by thy name.
verses.sm: ia e faafofoga mai mai le lagi, o le mea o loo e afio ai, ma e faia e tusa ma mea uma e valaau atu ai le tagata ese ia te oe ; ina ia iloa lou suafa e nuu uma lava i le lalolagi, ma ia latou matatau ia te oe, e faapei o lou nuu o Isaraelu, ia latou iloa foi ua igoa i lou suafa lenei fale ua ou faia.

verses.en: If thy people go out to battle against their enemy, whithersoever thou shalt send them, and shall pray unto the LORD toward the city which thou hast chosen, and toward the house that I have built for thy name:
verses.sm: Afai e o atu lou nuu e tau le taua ma e ua ita mai ia te i latou, i se mea e te aauina atu ai i latou, ma latou talotalo atu ia Ieova o faasaga mai i le aai ua e filifilia, ma le fale ua ou faia mo lou suafa;

verses.en: Then hear thou in heaven their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause.
verses.sm: ia e faafofoga mai i le lagi i a latou tatalo ma a latou aioi, ma ia e fai le faamasinoga mo i latou.

verses.en: If they sin against thee, (for there is no man that sinneth not,) and thou be angry with them, and deliver them to the enemy, so that they carry them away captives unto the land of the enemy, far or near;
verses.sm: Pe afai latou te agasala atu ia te oe, (auā e leai se tagata e le agasala,) ma e toasa mai ia te i latou, ma e tuuina i latou i e ita mai ia te i latou, ma latou ave ia te i latou faatagataotaua i le nuu o e ita mai, pe mamao pe latalata mai;

verses.en: Yet if they shall bethink themselves in the land whither they were carried captives, and repent, and make supplication unto thee in the land of them that carried them captives, saying, We have sinned, and have done perversely, we have committed wickedness;
verses.sm: afai e toe manatu o latou loto i le nuu e avea i ai i latou o faatagataotaua, ma latou liliu mai, ma aioi mai ia te oe i le nuu o e ave ia te i latou faatagataotaua, ma latou faapea atu, Ua matou agasala, ma faapiopio, ua amio leaga i matou:

verses.en: And so return unto thee with all their heart, and with all their soul, in the land of their enemies, which led them away captive, and pray unto thee toward their land, which thou gavest unto their fathers, the city which thou hast chosen, and the house which I have built for thy name:
verses.sm: afai latou te liliu mai ia te oe ma o latou loto atoa, ma o latou agaga atoa i le nuu o e ita mai ia te i latou, o e ave ia te i latou faatagataotaua, ma latou talotalo ia te oe o faasaga mai i lo latou nuu na e foaiina mai i o latou tamā, o le aai na e filifilia, ma le fale ua ou faia mo lou suafa;

verses.en: Then hear thou their prayer and their supplication in heaven thy dwelling place, and maintain their cause,
verses.sm: ia e faafofoga mai mai le lagi, -o le mea o loo e afio ai, i a latou tatalo ma a latou aioi, ma ia e fai le faamasinoga mo i latou,

verses.en: And forgive thy people that have sinned against thee, and all their transgressions wherein they have transgressed against thee, and give them compassion before them who carried them captive, that they may have compassion on them:
verses.sm: ma e faamagalo mai i lou nuu o e na agasala atu ia te oe, i o latou solitulafono uma ua latou soli ai au tulafono, ma ia e pule ia alofaina i latou e i latou o e ave ia te i latou faatagataotaua, ia latou alolofa ia te i latou ;

verses.en: For they be thy people, and thine inheritance, which thou broughtest forth out of Egypt, from the midst of the furnace of iron:
verses.sm: auā o lou nuu ma lou tofi i latou, na e aumaia mai le nuu o Aikupito, mai totonu o le ogaumu e tunu ai uamea;

verses.en: That thine eyes may be open unto the supplication of thy servant, and unto the supplication of thy people Israel, to hearken unto them in all that they call for unto thee.
verses.sm: ia silasila mai ou fofoga i le aioi a lau auauna, ma le aioi a lou nuu o Isaraelu, ia e faafofoga mai ia te i latou i mea uma latou te valaau atii ai ia te oe.

verses.en: For thou didst separate them from among all the people of the earth, to be thine inheritance, as thou spakest by the hand of Moses thy servant, when thou broughtest our fathers out of Egypt, O Lord GOD.
verses.sm: Auā le Alii e, Ieova, na e vavae mai ia te i latou ai nuu uma i le lalolagi e fai mou tofi, e faapei o lau afioga na aumaia e lau auauna o Mose, ina ua e au mai i o matou tamā mai Aikupito.

verses.en: And it was so, that when Solomon had made an end of praying all this prayer and supplication unto the LORD, he arose from before the altar of the LORD, from kneeling on his knees with his hands spread up to heaven.
verses.sm: Ua faaumaina e Solomona ona tatalo ia ieova i lenei tatalo ma lenei aioi uma, ona tulai lea o ia mai luma o le fata faitaulaga o ieova, sa tootuli ai ona tulivae, ma faaloaloa ae ona lima i le lagi.

verses.en: And he stood, and blessed all the congregation of Israel with a loud voice, saying,
verses.sm: Ona tu lea o ia, ma faamanuia atu i le faapotopotoga uma o Isaraelu ua leo tele, ua faapea atu,

verses.en: Blessed be the LORD, that hath given rest unto his people Israel, according to all that he promised: there hath not failed one word of all his good promise, which he promised by the hand of Moses his servant.
verses.sm: Ia faafetaia Ieova o le ua foaiina mai le malologa i lona nuu o Isaraelu, e tusa ma mea uma na ia fetalaia mai ai, e leai se upu e tasi ua le taunuu o ana upu lelei uma na ia folafolaina mai na faaoo mai e lana auauna o Mose.

verses.en: The LORD our God be with us, as he was with our fathers: let him not leave us, nor forsake us:
verses.sm: la ia te i tatou Ieova lo tatou Atua, e pei ona i ai o ia i o tatou tamā; aua ne‘i tuua i tatou e ia; aua foi ne‘i lafoaiina i tatou e ia;

verses.en: That he may incline our hearts unto him, to walk in all his ways, and to keep his commandments, and his statutes, and his judgments, which he commanded our fathers.
verses.sm: ina ia faaliliuina e ia o tatou loto ia te ia, ia tatou savavali i ona ala uma, ma tatou tausi i ana poloaiga, ma ana tulafono, ma ana faamasinoga, na ia poloai mai ai i o tatou tamā.

verses.en: And let these my words, wherewith I have made supplication before the LORD, be nigh unto the LORD our God day and night, that he maintain the cause of his servant, and the cause of his people Israel at all times, as the matter shall require:
verses.sm: O a‘u upu nei foi ua ou aioi atu ai i luma o ieova, ia latalata ia ia Ieova lo tatou Atua i le ao atoa ma le po, ia faia e ia le faamasinoga mo laua auauna, ma le faamasinoga mo lona nuu o Isaraelu, o le aso ma lana mea;

verses.en: That all the people of the earth may know that the LORD is God, and that there is none else.
verses.sm: ina ia iloa e nuu uma i le lalolagi, o ieova o le Atua ia, e leai se tasi.

verses.en: Let your heart therefore be perfect with the LORD our God, to walk in his statutes, and to keep his commandments, as at this day.
verses.sm: O lenei, ia atoatoa o outou loto ia Ieova lo tatou Atua, e savavali i ana tulafono, ma tausi i ana poloaiga, e faapei ona fai i le aso nei.

verses.en: And the king, and all Israel with him, offered sacrifice before the LORD.
verses.sm: Ua fai taulaga le tupu, ma le nuu uma o Isaraelu faatasi ma ia i luma o Ieova.

verses.en: And Solomon offered a sacrifice of peace offerings, which he offered unto the LORD, two and twenty thousand oxen, and an hundred and twenty thousand sheep. So the king and all the children of Israel dedicated the house of the LORD.
verses.sm: Ua faia foi e Solomona o le taulaga faafetai, na ia faia ia ieova, o povi e lua sefulu o afe ma afe e lua, ma mamoe e selau afe ma afe e luafulu. Ua faapea ona faaulufaleina o le fale o Ieova e le tupu ma le fanauga a Isaraelu uma.

verses.en: The same day did the king hallow the middle of the court that was before the house of the LORD: for there he offered burnt offerings, and meat offerings, and the fat of the peace offerings: because the brasen altar that was before the LORD was too little to receive the burnt offerings, and meat offerings, and the fat of the peace offerings.
verses.sm: O lea lava aso na faapaiaina ai e le tupu o le lotoā i totonu i luma o le fale o ieova; auā na faia e ia i lea mea o taulaga mu, ma taulaga i mea e ‘ai, ma le ga‘o o taulaga faafetai; auā sa itiiti le fata faitaulaga ‘apa memea i luma o ieova, na le ofi ai taulaga mu, ma taulaga i mea e ‘ai, ma le ga4o o taulaga faafetai.

verses.en: And at that time Solomon held a feast, and all Israel with him, a great congregation, from the entering in of Hamath unto the river of Egypt, before the LORD our God, seven days and seven days, even fourteen days.
verses.sm: O ona po ia na fai ai e Solomona ma Isaraelu uma faatasi ma ia, o le tausamiga i luma o Ieova lo tatou Atua, o le faapotopotoga tele, e afua mai i le mea e ui atu ai i Amato, e gata mai i le alia o Aikupito, o po e fitu ma po e fitu, ua atoa ai po e sefulu ma le fa.

verses.en: On the eighth day he sent the people away: and they blessed the king, and went unto their tents joyful and glad of heart for all the goodness that the LORD had done for David his servant, and for Israel his people.
verses.sm: O lona po valu ua tuuina atu ai e ia o le nuu ; ua latou faamanuia atu foi i le tupu, ma latou o i o latou fale ie ma le olioli ma le loto fiafia, ona o niea lelei uma na faia e ieova mo lana auauna o Tavita, ma lona nuu o Isaraelu. 0 le ajio mai o le Ataa ia Solomo:ia.
